result.brief: 提出 InfraWorld 路侧 4D 占据预测世界模型，用稠密 BEV 状态加持久运动查询分别建模全局上下文与局部动态，并通过长短期时序融合与运动感知查询注入实现选择性状态演化。
result.reason: Roadside 4D occupancy forecasting world model with dense BEV state plus motion queries; a 3D/4D environment world-modeling contribution rather than a general video foundation model.
